provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Bakery

examples.psychological_goal: 一句假设把观众的拥有幻想变成共同语境
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称幻想式开场（so you want to own X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to own a bakery.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"所以你想拥有一家X"直接开局，先给幻想再给反转

examples.psychological_goal: 用信息差预告把注意力推到峰值
examples.expression_mechanism: 信号灯短句加信息差（the thing nobody tells you before X）
examples.example_text: Here is the thing nobody tells you before you sign the lease.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在反转前用"没人告诉你的事"制造信息差张力
examples.negative_instruction: 信号句之后必须立刻交付实质反差，不得空挂悬念

examples.psychological_goal: 把月收入数字变成一场可跟随的资金旅程
examples.expression_mechanism: 跟钱走方法宣言（follow where the money actually goes）
examples.example_text: But, let us follow where that $45,000 actually goes.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"跟着钱走"把抽象分析转成具象追踪

examples.psychological_goal: 中段第一次大回报：顶线被减到个位数净利
examples.expression_mechanism: 判词式数字收束（a net margin of roughly X）
examples.example_text: That is a net margin of roughly 8 to 9%.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在长串减法后用一句净利率判词落地
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该数值；判词前必须有完整减法铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 把抽象浪费换算成一笔可感知的单日损失
examples.expression_mechanism: 单笔账具象化（X in direct losses from one batch on one day）
examples.example_text: $72 in direct losses from one batch on one day.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把比例型浪费换算成"一笔一单一天"的实账
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该金额与品类

examples.psychological_goal: 用反直觉断言为运营层反转开门
examples.expression_mechanism: 反直觉对仗断言（more X does not always mean more Y）
examples.example_text: Selling more does not always mean making more money.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"更多X不等于更多Y"开启反直觉章节
examples.negative_instruction: 断言后必须紧跟机制解释，不得只抛不证

examples.psychological_goal: 交付"越忙越不赚"的悖论答案
examples.expression_mechanism: 双重比较级悖论判词（busier than ever and less profitable）
examples.example_text: You can be busier than ever and less profitable than you were when it was quieter.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个比较级并置完成悖论收束

examples.psychological_goal: 用时段集中度数字重设对营收节奏的认知
examples.expression_mechanism: 占比加时间窗的集中度揭示（X% of daily sales happen between A and B）
examples.example_text: Roughly 65 to 80% of daily sales happen between 7:00 in the morning and 10:00 in the morning.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"占比加时间窗"一句话呈现结构性集中
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比例与时段

examples.psychological_goal: 用拟人化短句让固定成本的压迫感落地
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化否定短句（X does not pause）
examples.example_text: Rent does not pause between 10:00 and 5:00.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X不停摆"的拟人短句为长枚举收束
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句；拟人对象是成本项而非人

examples.psychological_goal: 用极端毛利对比打开利润杠杆的想象
examples.expression_mechanism: 单品毛利揭示（a gross margin of X% on Y alone）
examples.example_text: That is a gross margin of 90% on the coffee alone.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"alone"限定词突出组合中单一品类的杠杆作用
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比例与品类

examples.psychological_goal: 把视角从"卖多少"切换到"卖什么组合"
examples.expression_mechanism: 视角切换陈述（the mix matters enormously）
examples.example_text: The product mix matters enormously in a bakery
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"组合比总量更重要"的陈述完成分析维度换挡
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该行业限定；换挡后必须给出组合层证据

examples.psychological_goal: 用镜像句式把定价差距升格为生死差距
examples.expression_mechanism: 镜像对照（the difference between X is the difference between Y and Z）
examples.example_text: The difference between those two numbers is the difference between building a viable custom cake business and slowly hemorrhaging money on every order.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用镜像句把数字差翻译成结局差
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式中的具体业务与金额

examples.psychological_goal: 用"先还约四分之三"的阈值感解释脆弱性
examples.expression_mechanism: 阈值占比揭示（the first X% just to cover what it owes）
examples.example_text: On a typical operating day, the bakery needs to clear roughly the first 74% of its sales volume just to cover what it owes.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把盈亏平衡翻译成"先还掉前X%销量的债"

examples.psychological_goal: 全片最重一击：账面利润被重新定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 定义重构（simply paying X below market rate and calling the difference profit）
examples.example_text: It is simply paying the owner below market rate for their labor and calling the difference profit.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"只是把A叫作B"的句式拆穿会计幻象
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该表述；重构前必须给出替换成本的算账

examples.psychological_goal: 把熟客从感觉变成资产负债表外资产
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位价值命名（the economic value of one X）
examples.example_text: That is the economic value of one regular.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习为无形资产给出"单个单位价值"的命名句
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该资产类型；命名前必须有终身账铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 用原则判词反转"新奇才有竞争力"的直觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 优先级反转判词（X matters more than Y）
examples.example_text: This is why consistency matters more than novelty in a bakery.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X比Y更重要"的判词沉淀段落论证
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该原则的具体行业表述

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众的日常消费场景改造成内行审视场景
examples.expression_mechanism: 反问重构（try a different question. Not just X? Ask Y）
examples.example_text: try a different question. Not just what does this croissant cost? Ask how much of that price is still in the owner's pocket
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"换一个问法"把行业结论变成观众可带走的视角
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该问句的具体对象

examples.psychological_goal: 把全片从单一行业升格为通用商业世界观
examples.expression_mechanism: 通用化收束（every business that looks X from the outside and reveals Y only to insiders）
examples.example_text: but about every business that looks profitable from the outside and reveals its real economics only to the people on the inside.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"每个看起来X的生意都只对内行展示Y"完成升格

warnings: no_humor_type_examples: source narration contains no genuine humor mechanism (only isolated dry irony), so the humor type is intentionally not covered; all six required types are covered
